title: Skeleton in Cosmic Forest
description: A skeletal figure with flowing green hair, dressed in a maroon Victorian coat, dances dynamically while holding a glowing pink smartphone. The scene is framed by a vibrant stained-glass border, with a glowing green horse-like creature galloping on a cosmic circular platform below, set against a mystical forest backdrop with light rays, lotuses, and scattered armor pieces.
prompt: A skeletal figure with vibrant green flowing hair, wearing an ornate maroon Victorian tailcoat with a white flower, dancing dynamically on one leg while holding a glowing pink smartphone emitting light. Below, a luminous green spectral horse gallops across a circular cosmic platform with purple and blue nebulae patterns. The entire scene is enclosed in an ornate, colorful stained glass arch with geometric segments in red, blue, and purple. Mystical forest background with sunbeams breaking through trees, white lotuses, mossy ground, tree stump with helmet and scattered feathers, in a highly detailed fantasy surrealism style.
